## 1. Overall Health Assessment

The project has strong cumulative velocity (4,842 closed issues) but is carrying a concerning amount of aged unresolved work: 20 open issues are over 200 days old, one production showstopper (payment duplication bug) has been sitting for 40 days, and 21% of open issues have gone stale. The active pipeline is thin — only 3 issues are In Progress — suggesting the team is stretching to cover backlog rather than making fresh throughput.

## 2. Top 3 Risks Requiring Immediate Attention

- **Production showstopper aging:** Issue #5925 (warrant payment duplication) has been open 40 days. This directly impacts court financial operations and should be the #1 priority.
- **Massive aged backlog of unresolved bugs:** At least 10 open issues are 200+ days old, including missing SMS notifications to accused persons (#5902), broken
